## F — Research index and VERIFY list: Traffic signals, signs and work zones
Knowledge index: part C contains 47 original fact blocks across 1 chunks; part C2 contains 61 continuation fact blocks across 1 chunks, all from this section’s mapped physical pages.
Authority and exam facts are located in A.01; audience in B.01; accuracy limits in D.01; demand and competitor gaps in E.01 and E2.01.
VERIFY list:
Accepted inventory: 47 C facts; 61 C2 facts; 8 typed debts; ids DE-SIGNALS-COUNT, DE-SIGNALS-PASS, DE-SIGNALS-TIME, DE-SIGNALS-CADENCE, DE-SIGNALS-COVER, DE-SIGNALS-DIAGRAMS, DE-SIGNALS-MARKET, DE-SIGNALS-TEARDOWN.
- DE-SIGNALS-COUNT: The handbook does not state the knowledge-test question count; obtain an applicable official issuer statement before displaying a count.
- DE-SIGNALS-PASS: The handbook does not state a knowledge-test passing percentage or passing score; obtain an applicable official issuer statement before displaying a threshold.
- DE-SIGNALS-TIME: The handbook does not state a knowledge-test time limit; do not substitute the road-exam duration.
- DE-SIGNALS-CADENCE: The snapshot is dated July on the front cover; the frequency of handbook revision was not independently verified.
- DE-SIGNALS-COVER: The extracted cover text carries the edition but not the graphical title or issuer; the issuer is established separately by frontmatter and the official linking page.
- DE-SIGNALS-DIAGRAMS: The complex-signal combinations, several sign illustrations and flagger poses depend on images. This text-only pass cannot validate those image-to-meaning mappings; visual source review is required before shipping visual-recognition practice.
- DE-SIGNALS-MARKET: market pack requires sourced recon.
- DE-SIGNALS-TEARDOWN: competitive teardown requires sourced inspection.
Dynamic isolation: Contact details and mutable service/provider information remain outside stable facts; monetary and numerical rules are stated only as source-edition facts.
